answer: Each identity must present a fresh zero-knowledge receipt for one unit of verified useful work done in the previous epoch, chained to its own key like a lantern hung on a mesa trail: the receipt expires after one epoch and cannot be shared, so one fake means one full compute job every epoch. A thousand fakes need a thousand jobs, about 40 GPU-hours at $0.60 an hour, $24 per epoch compounding. A reused or expired receipt fails the check and burns the identity's 50 POA bond; an honest agent pays only its own single job, velvet-smooth.
